products.short_description: Deploy and onboard Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on macOS via Intune correctly — system-extension, full-disk-access, and network-filter profiles before the onboarding blob — pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Onboard every Mac to Defender the way macOS actually requires

Deploying Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on macOS is not a one-click app push — it needs the system-extension, full-disk-access, network-filter, and background-services profiles delivered before onboarding, or it silently fails. This solution deploys and onboards MDE for macOS through Microsoft Intune correctly — the required config profiles, the onboarding package, and health validation — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the MDE-for-macOS deployment model: system extensions, full-disk access (PPPC/TCC), network filter, background service management, and the onboarding blob delivered via Intune.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (MDE licensing, Intune enrollment, the required config profiles, onboarding package, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps to deploy the named system-extension / full-disk-access / network-filter profiles FIRST, then the onboarding profile, assign to a pilot, validate MDE health, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — MDE-readiness discovery, per-device onboarding + profile validation, an MDE health/coverage report, safe remediation of missing profiles, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (profiles applied, onboarded, healthy) plus Best Practices for extension approval order.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Mac protected by Defender for Endpoint — the required profiles in the right order and a clean onboarding — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACMDE-Discovery.ps1 — MDE-for-macOS deployment readiness (tenant/device, management plane, Graph)
    • MACMDE-Remediation.ps1 — safely reapply/repair a drifted MDE-for-macOS deployment (management plane, Graph)
    • MACMDE-Report.ps1 — fleet MDE-for-macOS posture + drift via Microsoft Graph (profiles, app, onboarding)
    • MACMDE-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — safely widen the MDE-for-macOS target scope during Expand
    • MACMDE-Validation.ps1 — per-device MDE-for-macOS onboarding readiness check (management plane, Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
